summary: Tested new AI product-info + enhance-photo admin endpoints and the anti-spoofing regression on live chat/presence. All 10 pytest cases PASSED (auth guards, bad foto_url -> 400, real JPEG upload -> valid Indonesian nama/deskripsi/kategori, Nano Banana enhance returns fetchable image/*, buyer name-spoof attempts on /live/chat and /live/presence are overridden by the account name, guest can still pick a name, product CRUD regression). Frontend product-form loads for admin; ai-generate-info button is correctly aria-disabled when 0 photos; add-photo and product-nama/deskripsi/kategori testIDs present; enhance-photo-<i> button is only rendered per uploaded thumbnail (verified in source). Native image picker cannot be driven from Playwright web, so the enabled-after-upload transition and the hint-error text path could not be exercised end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2099 lines; consider splitting into modules (auth/live/products/ai) for maintainability.
AI endpoints have no per-admin rate limiting; a runaway loop from the UI could burn Emergent credits fast. Consider basic throttling.
seed_data_creation: Test-only live show 'TEST_iter29_live' was created and torn down (stopped + recap deleted). Test products prefixed 'TEST_iter29_produk' were also fully deleted. No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI product-info + enhance-photo work against Emergent Universal LLM key. To exercise the endpoints, upload a real JPEG with visual features via POST /api/upload (admin) first, then pass the returned url to the AI endpoints. Enhance-photo can take up to ~40s. Anti-spoof rule: for authenticated (non-guest) users the server ignores payload.name and uses viewer['name'] on /live/chat AND /live/presence.
